entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: There's too many couples here.[n]What's the point of having a date[n]at an aquarium?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's too dark to see anything, and all[n]you do is stare at fish. See? That guy[n]over there is yawning.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If you're gonna have a date, at least[n]pick someplace mature. That's what I[n]would do.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's crazy, right? Why not pick something[n]more romantic?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You seem like the kinda guy who'd pick[n]the right date spots.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh!? Uhh... Come on, you know!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Destinyland! Lights, colors! Nothing's[n]more romantic than that!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You think...? I mean, I guess it is nice[n]and quiet.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But it just doesn't have the right vibe.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Is looking at fish really that exciting?[n]These people are supposed to be[n]grown-ups.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Holy crap... Its teeth are insane...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I take back what I said. I mean, anyone[n]would get hype seeing a shark.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Okay, let's go check out the exhibit[n]over there!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's cool to step out of the arcade once[n]in a while. I had a blast. Thanks!
